programme.title: Teen Mom
programme.desc: Maci går ut med jentene og møter en gammel flamme. Babygråt og urealistiske forventninger ødelegger Amber og Garys romantiske middag. Tyler har dårlig samvittighet etter adopsjonen, og Farrah avslører en hemmelighet om barnefaren.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Når Lauren Conrad må mestre både moteskolen, en krevende praktikantjobb og en uforutsigbar romkamerat som ødelegger for henne, forstår hun raskt at alt er stort i Los Angeles, også hennes egne problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Når Heidi fikser et intervju for drømmejobben som får henne til å overveie å hoppe av skolen permanent, forstår Lauren at hun og Heidi kanskje har helt forskjellige mål.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren på et oppdrag til New York City, men vel tilbake i L.A. venter det henne en stor overraskelse fra fortiden. Heidi skjønner at å jobbe med festreklamering ikke bare er en fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eksflamme fra Laguna Beach, dukker opp igjen i livet hennes, forstår hun at hun kanskje ikke er så ferdig med ham som hun trodde. Samtidig, i sin nye jobb, spør Heidi seg om det egentlig er verdt alt strevet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Fade to Black
programme.desc: Paulie og Mike må sjonglere flere grupper med jenter. Det blir slåsskamp i baren, og en av deltakerne blir slått ned.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Just Another Day at the Shore
programme.desc: Med støtte fra de fleste av de andre er Snooki på bedringens vei. Ronnies familie kommer på besøk, og Sammi ønsker å gjøre et godt førsteinntrykk. JWoww blir lei folkene i klubben og havner i slåsskamp.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Boardwalk Blowups
programme.desc: Mike ber jenter til huset, og situasjonen kommer ut av kontroll. Snooki havner i slåsskamp igjen. Ronnie havner også i bråk, og Sammi begynner å tvile på forholdet deres.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia ønsker å flytte litt utenfor byen - men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads sin hjelp kjøper de en bolig som har nøyaktig alt de ikke liker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 401
programme.desc: I første episode møter vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende åtte millioner å kjøpe hus og pusse opp for. Men det store budsjettet har ikke hjulpet dem så langt - kan ekspertene være til hjelp?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 402
programme.desc: Ekspertene drar til Hørning, der presten og hennes familie trenger et nytt sted å bo. De leier et lite rekkehus og nå vil de gjerne flytte.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om å bytte ut sine lille leiebolig på Nørrebro med en murervilla i Hillerød. Men de angrer bittert på at de har spurt ekspertene om hjelp når de får se huset pengene gikk til.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små barn - og en drøm om å bo sammen med besteforeldrene. Så ekspertene leter etter et hus som har plass til to familier, med plass til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 310
programme.desc: Vi møter bodybuilderen Ulla som ønsket seg kvinnelige bryster, men som nå har så store implantater at hun har vanskelig for å trene. Patrik har fått fjernet hud på magen, men er misfornøyd.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 606
programme.desc: Claudia går ned 100 kilo og får deretter fjernet overflødig hud. For å avslutte reisen mot en kropp som Claudia kan føle seg stolt av, bestemte hun seg for å gjøre en brystforstørrelsesoperasjon.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 301
programme.desc: I dag møter vi bl.a. Jane, som ikke lenger har lyst på sex på grunn av de stygge brystene sine, og Julie, som misliker seg selv på grunn av de store arrene hun fikk etter en brystreduksjon.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 904
programme.desc: Jeannes bryster hindrer henne i å leve et normalt liv. Gitte skammer seg over beina og bruker enormt mye tid og energi på å skjule dem.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 308
programme.desc: Lizette sitter igjen med et knallhardt bryst etter en forstørrende operasjon, mens Diana går med voldsomme smerter etter en brystreduksjon. Begge håper de å få hjelp av de erfarne kirurgene.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 503
programme.desc: Under sin siste fødsel gjennomgikk Sonja et akutt keisersnitt som, noe utradisjonelt, ble kuttet vertikalt på Sonjas mage. Sonjas navle ble kuttet opp, og resultatet er til en stor ulempe for henne.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tash On Tours
programme.desc: Med Charlotte i hus igjen, tenker alle på Gary og Marnie og om de vil ligge sammen igjen. Gjengen tar 'Tash-On' - turer til Manchester for å vise Geordie-taktikken på singel-kveldene: Bli dritings og klin i vei.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Boy
programme.desc: Det spisser seg til når Aaron overhører Vicky og jentene sladre om ham samme kveld han har tredje date med Vicky. Og mens gutta jobber ute, får jentene en kjempeoverraskelse - en ny gutt, Kyle, kommer for å bli en del av familien.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Trip To Iceland
programme.desc: Den nye gutten Kyle gjør seg hjemmekoselig i huset gjennom å tilbringe natten med Holly, og Geordie-gjengen og deres 'Tash on Tours' blir internasjonale når de flyr til Reykjavik på Island for utagerende festing.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Marnie Exposes Gary
programme.desc: Etter å ha sjekket ut Islands gutter, jenter og geysirer, vender Geordie-gjengen tilbake til Toon. Der spisser det seg til når Aaron og Scott får høre sannheten om Gary og Marnie, og Garys tvilsomme guttekodeks.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Boss
programme.desc: Buzzin! Våre favorittfestløver er tilbake og alle sjokkeres av at Vicky blir sjefen deres. Holly vil ikke virke billig, derfor vil hun ikke ligge med Kyle, og Marnie dumper Aaron når hun oppdager at han har løyet for henne.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Party Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Holly har fest, men gutta braker sammen når Marnie prøver å gjøre Aaron sjalu ved å kline med Kyle. Sjefen Vicky arrangerer singelkveld for homofile, og Charlotte avslører at det kan bli slutt med kjæresten.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: What Happens in the AC
programme.desc: Gjengen drar til Atlantic City, der moro blir til alvor idet Mike støter fra seg både Snooki og Jwoww. En av deltakerne avslører at hun har hatt spiseforstyrrelser.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: One Shot

programme.title: iCarly: Moren til Sam
programme.desc: Etter å ha kranglet ned moren sin, flytter Sam inn til Carly, som snart innser at hun er en fryktelig gjest. Freddie blir forfulgt av en farlig kriminell etter å ha fanget ham på film da han begikk en forbrytelse.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel trenger hjelp
programme.desc: Når en video av Nevel, som skriker til en liten jente, dukker opp på internett, blir Nevel hatet av alle. Men Nevel trygler iCarly-gjengen om hjelp for å redde sin ære.

programme.title: iCarly: Den kjekke assistenten
programme.desc: Carly og Sam ansetter en kjekk fyr som praktikant på nettshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: iOMG
programme.desc: Gjengen tilbringer kvelden med å fullføre sine prosjekter ved Ridgeway under den årlige skole-innlåsingen. Carly og Freddie mistenker at Sam er forelsket i sin nye venn Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty med Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistenker at den nye typen hennes, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så gjengen planlegger en tur til Los Angeles for å ta ham på fersken på en fest som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjelpen
programme.desc: Carly trår til for å løse en krangel mellom Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for å få hjelp med hver eneste krangel. Nå som hun har involvert seg, hvordan kan Carly trekke seg ut av det igjen?

programme.title: iCarly: Det holder
programme.desc: Mrs Benson oppdager Sam og Freddies forhold etter at Gibby - som nå er mål for Sams hevn - har lagt planer om å splitte dem. Kommer Carly til å slåss for Sam og Freddie, eller hjelpe Gibby med å få dem til å gå fra hverandre?

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg elsker deg
programme.desc: Carly ber Sam og Freddie om å prøve hverandres yndlingshobbier. I mens treffer Spencer på sin gamle barnevakt og ber henne ut på middag. Etter at de har falt inn i sine gamle roller igjen, kommer de fortsatt til å kunne være sammen?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved å prøve å virke smartere enn hun er. Og gjengen prøver å finne et nytt sted å bo til T-Bo, etter at han har blitt kastet ut av Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den som Xever får se
programme.desc: Leo frykter at hans milde behandling av Xever vil straffe seg når Xever holder en lokal kafeinnehaver som gissel.

programme.desc: Når April mottar en advarsel fra sin fangede far, må hun og Turtles ut på et oppdrag for å redde ham og stoppe Kraang fra å detonere en mutagenbombe i byen

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Panikk i kloakken
programme.desc: Turtles må forsvare hjemmet sitt i kloakken når Bradford prøver å ødelegge det med et farlig kjemikalie.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mousers angrep
programme.desc: Når simultane trusler tvinger Turtles til å dele seg i to grupper, må Donnie og Mikey bevise at deres "B-lag" er like verdifullt som Leo og Raphs "A-lag."

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Det kom fra dypet
programme.desc: Michelangelo blir venn med en ustabil mutant-alligator som besitter en merkelig bit av Kraang-teknologi. Men kan de stole på ham?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den nye jenta
programme.desc: Leonardo er lei av Raphs evige kritikk, og lar broren prøve seg som leder. Samtidig møter Leonardo en vakker men farlig kvinnelig ninja.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Jeg, Monster
programme.desc: Turtles møter en ny motstander, Rottekongen, som ikke bare truer å ta kontroll over byen, men også Splinters hjerne.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En hemmelig agenda
programme.desc: Når Aprils skoleprosjekt tiltrekker seg Kraangs oppmerksomhet, må Turtles takle den videregående skolen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Pulverisereren

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: TCRI
programme.desc: Skilpaddene oppdager kraangenes sanne hensikter når de bryter seg inn i TCRI-hovedkvarteret.

programme.desc: Sabrina is distraught when she receives her first “C” ever on a class assignment and turns to Zelda for counseling. Zelda ends up conducting her own private tutoring session with Sabrina’s handsome professor.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Sabrina opts to spend a picture-perfect Christmas with Morgan and her family rather than endure the annual insanity with Hilda and Zelda. She soon discovers the ugly secrets under the flawless façade.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: My Best Shot
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to give Josh a little confidence booster in his new passion to be a photographer, but her simple spell to help him make his first sale leads to his getting a big head and walking out on his job at the coffeehouse.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Tick-Tock Hilda’s Clock
programme.desc: When Sabrina throws Hilda a surprise party for her 650th birthday, Hilda becomes depressed that she doesn’t have a husband or family yet. Things go from bad to worse when Sabrina loses the out-of-whack biological clock.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s New Roommate
programme.desc: When Sabrina reluctantly takes in Zelda for a few days while Hilda’s on a home remodeling binge, Sabrina and her roommates try to loosen up her uptight Aunt Zelda.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Making the Grade
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to right a wrong when she writes an article for the school paper exposing the preferential treatment given to school athletes, but she inadvertently puts Roxie's scholarship in jeopardy.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Love is a Many Complicated Thing
programme.desc: Sabrina agrees to a double date on Valentine's Day with Josh and Morgan, but by the end of the date she finds herself in the middle of her friends' break up.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Muse

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Beach Blanket Bizarro

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Witchright Hall

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Activist

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood ta reda på vilken båt de föredrar i 'Landjaking', lista ut alla sätt ett barn kan sitta fast i 'Småbarnsfällor' och snacka med ouppmärksamma människor i 'Rumsouppfattning'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och gästen Lolo Wood bli skrämda av sprutor i 'Petpanik', få svar på tal i 'Ge igen-attacker' och känna sig däckade i 'Överkörda'.

programme.title: The Hills
programme.desc: Whitney och Lauren jobbar på Young Hollywood Party och Heidi firar sin 21:a födelsedag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi och Lauren har ett nytt offentligt gräl, som får Heidi att komma tillbaka och be Lauren om ursäkt för allt som hänt. Audrinas relation med Justin går på i gamla hjulspår, men karriären på Epic Records tar fart.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leker äktenskapsmäklare när Whitney går på sin första dejt med deras personlige tränare. Spencer motarbetar Heidis planer för ett sagobröllop, med ett gräl som hotar förlovningen som resultat.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina får syn på Justin när han kysser en annan tjej, vilket leder till en slutlig konfrontation om deras relation. Heidi blir chockad när Spencers syster Stephanie muckar gräl med Lauren och Brody på en nattklubb.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror att Brody kanske är för mycket av en playboy, för att hon ska kunna mena allvar med honom. Spencers syster berättar för honom att Heidi i hemlighet hyser tvivel inför deras bröllop.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får höra spännande nyheter på Teen Vogue och Heidi behöver komma bort från Spencer ett tag.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer äntligen iväg till Paris, men hennes drömresa blir nästan förstörd när hon upptäcker att Brody har hittat en ny. Spencer följer efter Heidi till Colorado, för att vinna tillbaka henne, men planen går i baklås.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney måste välja mellan tryggheten på Teen Vogue och riskerna med en ny karriär. Lauren och Brody hamnar i konflikt om hans nya flickvän och Heidi anpassar sig till ett liv utan Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en osannolik vän när Spenders syster Stephanie börjar på hennes modekurs. Whitney tycker att det nya jobbet är som en dröm, men en hektisk resa till New York får henne att minnas att man ska vara försiktig med vad man önskar sig.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi försöker vinna tillbaka Audrinas vänskap, men Lauren är misstänksam mot motiven bakom. Whitney anpassar sig till sitt nya jobb, men märker snabbt att hon saknar att jobba med Lauren.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: Ett vrålsnyggt ex anländer och skakar om villan. Jordan är ute efter Chloe, och när Marty söker tröst på annat håll uppstår ett Geordiebråk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Max Makes His Move
programme.desc: Det hettar till i villan när Chloe får Marty att bli rasande. Kärleken mellan Max och Georgia får nytt liv, och Dean har planer för Che, men kan ett nytt ex hälla grus i maskineriet?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Action Speak Louder Than Words
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan fortsätter orsaka förödelse på stranden. Stevie får skicka hem en person, Chloe kräver Sams uppmärksamhet, och Brads nya romans tar honom till sjunde himlen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Fight For Georgia
programme.desc: Kärlekens berg- och dalbana fortsätter för Chloe och Sam, med toppar och dalar. Max blir trött på Stevie och roar sig på annat håll, och när ett nytt ex anländer blir Georgia och Brad förvirrade.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Marty The Meddler
programme.desc: Klorna är ute när alla åker på safari och Dean känner sin status som alfahanne hotad. Marty lägger sig i Chloes och Sams förhållande och John har händerna fulla med Georgia.

programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar West Coast Customs Danelles Pontiac Trans Am. Hon rullar iväg i en bil utrustad med kaffebryggare och kristallkrona.

programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Ezras Nissan Maxima Station Wagon. Han rullar iväg i ett mobilt DJ-bås.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players

programme.desc: Svartsjukan är i centrum under en vild Mard Gras-fest. Geles blir huvudfienden när hon raggar på flera killar i huset. Dimitri hamnar i dålig dager hos Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team investigate the death of a minor league baseball player to determine if it was an accidental overdose of steroids or a homicide.

programme.desc: Don and his team investigate a trail of illegal waste disposal after a sinkhole, which collapses in a school playground, kills an elderly woman and injures several children. Kathy Najimy joins the cast in a recurring role as Charlie's new boss.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: During the murder investigation of a state senator, Don and his team discover a plot to exact revenge on the individuals involved in a government sponsored behavior modification project.

programme.title: Numb3rs

programme.title: Hobo With A Shotgun

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute ur bilden gör Heidi ett sista forsök att återvinna Laurens vänskap. När Audrina börjar umgås mer med Heidi och Justin ifrågasätter Lauren om de ska fortsätta att bo ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past

programme.desc: Lauren kläms mellan vänner när det blir spänt mellan Lo och Audrina. Efter att ha beslutat att det är slut med Spencer accepterar Heidi ett jobberbjudande som kommer att ta henne till Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen känner Audrina sig utestängd av Laurens nära vänskap med Lo och funderar på att flytta ut. Lauren gör ett innerligt försök att bli sams med Audrina, men det kan vara för sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: När säsong fyra börjar är läget mellan Audrina och Lo spänt. Lauren försöker göra gott intryck på en ny kille, och ett besök från Heidis syster Holly hotar Spencers och Heidis förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir ovän med sin bror och vän när Lauren springer på Spencer på hennes födelsedag. Kelly Cutrone sparkar nån på People's Revolution och Whitney fyller luckan. Laurens förhållande med Doug kanske går lite för fort fram.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren inser att personkemin hon hade med Doug i high school inte längre finns kvar. Whitney är nervös över att åka till New York, men en dejt med en snygg modell gör henne gladare. Trots försoningsgesten vill Spencer helt bryta med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En hejdundrande resa till Las Vegas går snett när Audrina ignorerar Lauren. Brody tar upp Stephanies förflutna, och grabbarna hamnar i finkan. Heidis syster Holly flyttar in, men Spencer vill inget hellre än att sparka ut henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina kämpar för att rädda sin vänskap, men det kan redan vara för sent. Spencer har fått nog av Heidis syster Holly och tar saken i egna händer. Och Brody och Doug lämnar häktet med nåt nytt att berätta.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Marty The Meddler
programme.desc: Klorna är ute när alla åker på safari och Dean känner sin status som alfahanne hotad. Marty lägger sig i Chloes och Sams förhållande och John har händerna fulla med Georgia.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Love Is In The Air
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan får fnatt och skickar Marty och Sam på en dejt. En nykomling får tvillingarna att strida medan Georgia och Johns förhållande bara blir starkare.

programme.desc: Strandpartyt på Bali får ett dramatiskt slut när den sista ankomsten skapar kaos i villan. Georgia och John faller vid sista hindret, och Chloe får till slut lite action från Sam.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Slash dyker upp

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den gode, den onde och Casey Jones

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Grottsvampen

programme.desc: En rundtur i Inveraray Castle på det skotska höglandet undersöker en värld av klankrig, spöksagor och keltiska spel.

programme.title: Aerial Ireland: Aerial Ireland
programme.desc: Besök ett land genomsyrat av tradition och naturlig skönhet från spektakulära höjd.

programme.desc: Historien bakom, har kanske inget att göra med vare sig gudar, magi eller ens människor.

programme.title: Million Dollar American Princesses: Meghan Markle
programme.desc: Se hur den kungliga sagan om prins Harry och Meghan Markle har många likheter med tidigare kungliga romanser.

programme.title: CBS News 24/7

programme.title: The Takeout with Major Garrett
programme.desc: The Takeout is a new spin on the widely acclaimed podcast hosted by Major Garrett; a daily streaming show that harnesses the best of CBS News' political reporting and lives comfortably in deep discussions.

programme.title: The Daily Report

programme.title: Combat Forces: Navy Divers
programme.desc: When your propeller is wrapped in fishing nets or the enemy has attached mines to your ship, there is one specially trained sailor who is trained to help save the day. Ship divers are charged with saving the ship and saving lives in rescue missions.

programme.title: The Final Year
programme.desc: En helt unik och väldigt närgången skildring av president Barack Obamas utrikespolitiska team under deras sista år vid makten. Allt detta var saker som i stort sett missades av amerikanska medier på grund av Donald Trumps presidentvalskampanj.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Big Sting
programme.desc: On December 22nd, 2000 three of the world's greatest art treasures were stolen from the National Museum in Stockholm. Together the Rembrandt and two Renoir paintings were valued at 50 million dollars.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Heavy Armor
programme.desc: Modern tanks are the equivalent of chariots on the battlefields of today. In Iraq and Afghanistan they are a soldier’s savior or an enemy’s nightmare. We join tank crews from several nations as they train for deployment to overseas hotspots.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Connector
programme.desc: Humankind, society and technology are dramatically influenced by science. In this episode we connect all the knowledge of The Mind of the Universe in an overarching outlook on the future. What is the future of humanity, society, and knowledge?

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger's Knock
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a house fire they discover a woman shot and killed inside. Police must unlock the mystery of who started the blaze to solve the murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Hanging By A Thread
programme.desc: Hillsborough County Florida is in the midst of a horrifying crime spree. Young women are turning up dead every week. Can one teen age girl's bravery bring an end to a vicious killer's reign of terror?

programme.title: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
programme.desc: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder at Loose Chippings
programme.desc: After a wealthy couple is found dead in their stately Virginia home, investigators are taken on a wild journey around the globe before they uncover the shocking truth.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in the Sun
programme.desc: When Kenny Baker returns home, the backdoor is ajar and his wife, Kathy, and two-year-old son, Ryan, are nowhere to be found.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Doghouse
programme.desc: Duane's decision to leave the Electra crew unsupervised while he spends time at home jeopardizes the completion of a major contract, and could cost him his job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Klovn: Den Japanska Trädgården
programme.desc: Casper och Iben ska gifta sig i Thailand, på åtta meters djup, så vännerna håller på att ta dykarcertifikat. Frank är stolt över rollen som best man men det trasslar till sig när han ska hjälpa Casper att klara upp sitt förflutna med Signe Lindkvist.

programme.title: Klovn: Trollkarlen Från Frederiksberg
programme.desc: Casper har blivit inbjuden till en prestigefylld orden men det finns ingen plats för Frank, till hans stora besvikelse. Men eftersom han skrivit en Sagan om ringen-analogi om politik blir han i alla fall inbjuden till en grupp lajvare.

programme.title: Klovn: Hör På Nu, Frank
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska åka till Kina men han oroar sig över att Muffi ska vara med Morten Olsens hund. Casper och Frank har börjat fäktas och här går snacket om impotens och Viagra.

programme.title: Klovn
programme.desc: Frank fyller 40 och det ska firas på Hotel Josty. Casper har varit hans bästa vän i 11 år och ska vara toastmaster. Men det blir konstig stämning när han i sitt tal erbjuder sperma så att Mia och Frank kan få barn.

programme.title: Klovn: Muffen Fäller
programme.desc: Det lackar mot jul och Mia och Frank ger varandra adventskalender-presenter. Frank får ett par skridskor och orsakar tumult på skridskobanan. Det blir också ett och annat obekvämt besök på kemtvätten.

programme.title: Klovn: Surprise Mia
programme.desc: Iben och Casper ska på brittiska filmgalan BAFTA och hon har med alla sina Louis Vuitton-väskor. Mia tvivlar på Franks kärlek och tänker att han hellre vill vara ihop med någon kändis, så han planerar en överraskning för henne.

programme.title: Klovn: Gotteligott
programme.desc: Casper är deppig och ligger mest i sin säng. Frank köper en videokamera för att muntra upp honom men Casper tycker inte att det händer något värt att filma. Samtidigt blir det stort drama i Mias butik och kameran är nyckeln till allt.

programme.title: Klovn: Shut Up
programme.desc: När Mias butik blir rättvisemärkt träffar Frank en fängslande kvinna. Men raggningsförsöket slutar i att han och Mia får husera en tibetansk flykting. Casper är deprimerad och tycker att han inte får cred för att han hjälpt komikerkollegor.

programme.title: Klovn: De Flätade Skorna Och Ägget
programme.desc: Mia vill skaffa en ny stol men Frank tycker inte att de ska lägga pengar på dyra möbler. Han vill hellre investera i en gräsklippare som ska delas med grannen. När Frank träffar en norsk tjej råkar han utge sig för att vara Muhammed-tecknare.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Keegan och Jordan tjuvlyssnar på vita kvinnor som fantiserar om svarta män, Wendell gör en egen musikvideo och Kareem och Jahar går på gym.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Parole Officer Puppet
programme.desc: En övervakare använder en docka för att knyta an till en villkorligt frigiven, en man med nackstöd försöker festa loss och en soldat har en känslosam återförening med sin familj.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: En gangster försöker desperat att visa att han är "loco", terrorister träffas för att planera sitt nästa drag och en avundsjuk bror gör familjemiddagen pinsam.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En footballspelare med hjärnskakning försöker inspirera sitt lag, en man anklagar sin fru för att vara otrogen med en hund och en restaurangägare skrämmer bort sina gäster.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Vi får se en footballspelare straffas för överdrivet firande, Jordan och Keegan gå på premiären av 'Othello' och en high school-elev som blir känd efter att ha stulit ett skämt från en klasskamrat.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: En kille jagar sin tjej till världens ände och LMFAO kan bokstavligen inte sluta partaja.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan och Keegan spelar två mystiker som kämpar om ensamrätten att få ge kloka råd. Dessutom ser vi när Jaden Smith diskuterar ett nytt manus med sin agent och när ett gaypar 'firar' den nya äktenskapslagen.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slappnar av hemma, Keegan måste skärpa sig på en jobbintervju, en skräddare har en kund med gaser, dörrvakterna diskuterar 'Game of Thrones' och en telefonförsäljare testar en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I seriens premiäravsnitt försöker Jordan Peele och Keegan-Michael Key att säga ett förbjudet ord om sina fruar, Lil Wayne anpassar sig till livet bakom galler och President Obama uttrycker vad han egentligen känner.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club
programme.desc: Ett inslag hjälper till att förhindra barn att bli soldater i Afrika, en a cappella-grupp i college får en ny medlem, Meegan och André går på sin första dejt, en terrorgrupp har en matbil och två gamla män diskuterar populärmusik.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: När Abbi förstår att hon är för snäll, ser hon till att bli mer bitchig. Ilana beslutar sig för att nå sin fulla potential. De går på ett exklusivt party och träffar några äventyrliga dj:ar. Nu kan inget gå fel.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana rider ut en kommande storm med Jaimé, Lincoln och Jeremy. Tyvärr får de också sällskap av Bevers och hans syster. De spelar 'Who Done It?' medan stormen rasar utanför.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana letar febrilt efter en sista-minutenpresent till Lincoln medan Abbi försöker att hitta en luftkonditionering för att få det svalt i sovrummet.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Det dyker upp nya möjligheter när Abbi äntligen lyckas att träna någon på Soulstice och Ilana gör succé som företagshöjdare.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi måste dra ut sina visdomständer och Ilana ser det som sin plikt att sköta om henne tills hon mår bättre - vilket självklart innebär en massa 'medikamenter' och en påtaglig brist på tillsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi och Jeremy går på en dejt som slutar med en överraskning medan Ilana och hennes mamma letar överallt efter den perfekta handväskan.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Tjejerna letar efter den perfekta festen, vilket avslöjar en underlig och surrealistisk sida hos Abbi som bekräftar Ilanas värsta farhågor.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong

programme.desc: After finding his beautiful 19 year old daughter dead, a father launches a relentless pursuit of her killer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: For Sale By Owner

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Meltdown
programme.desc: As spring arrives and Ray's retirement day approaches, Sean surprises everyone by leaving Buffalo for a job with the competition. So Buffalo brings in Electra pilot Brian Harrison to finish the contract.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: North Atlantic Convoy

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.desc: En manlig ballerina tvingas checka ut i kvällens parceremoni och vem det kommer vara är självklart för alla – eller? Allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2808

programme.title: Frusna vägar

programme.title: Frusna vägar

programme.title: Frusna vägar

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: I Åre försöker Robin rädda julen genom att hjälpa en postbil full med julklappar. Efter ett stort oväder i Sälen sitter både personbilar och tjänstefordon fast i snön och Hogan måste hjälpa till.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Katarina får jobba hårt när en personbil kolliderat med en älg. I Åre har ett hjul lossnat från en bil och Kent måste arbeta snabbt för att få bort den – men det visar sig vara lättare sagt än gjort.

programme.title: iCarly: iPearbutiken

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power

programme.title: Wild Mouse
programme.desc: Den berömde musikkritikern Georg (Josef Hader) får börja vända på pengarna när hans chefredaktör (Jörg Hartmann) plötsligt avskedar honom från tidningen i Wien som han har skrivit åt i flera decennier.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: Kör hårt
programme.desc: Rullskridskoåkaren Rosco lurar kåkfararen Doug att spöa upp några långtradarchaufförer som trängt honom av vägen. De får en väska fylld med dollar, en svit på Miamis finaste hotell och order att utge sig för att vara nyrika lantisar.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: Miami Supercops
programme.desc: Här kommer ännu en actionspäckad komedi från den dynamiska duon Hill och Spencer. I "Miami Supercops" ser vi våra hjältar jaga både brottslingar och 20 miljoner dollar som stals vid ett rån för ett par år sedan.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go (1967)
programme.desc: Under sin sista dag i flottan upptäcker grodmannen Elvis ett sjunket skattskepp. På sin första dag som civil börjar Elvis sitt nya jobb - en egenanställd skattjägare!

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Den legendariske komikern Andy Kaufmans liv och karriär.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta
programme.desc: Kara försöker skydda Mary Jane från resultatet från en fokusgrupp, Niecy försöker skydda sig själv och Treyvion från hans far, som plötsligt återvänder från college. Patrick försöker balansera arbete och familj och Mary Jane träffar Sheldon.

programme.title: Boomerang: Don't Wanna Love You
programme.desc: Inflytandets makt prövar när influencern Tia får ett välbetalt gig på en strippklubb, och David påverkas av en ny megakyrka.

programme.title: Boomerang: Reversal Of a Dog
programme.desc: Bryson får inte upp den i sovrummet, och håller inte tillbaka när han pratar om det hos frisören. Ari funderar på sin sexualitet och maskulinitet, och utmanar sin självbild.

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samlar gänget och deras respektive vid sin pappas lyxiga strandhus. Syftet är att ena alla, men resultatet blir att allas förändring tydliggörs, och risken finns att de splittras.

programme.title: Twenties: Pilot The Pilot
programme.desc: Den blivande manusförfattaren Hattie blir vräkt och arbetslös, men så träffar hon den etablerade författaren och producenten Ida B, vars serie "Cocoa's Butter" Hattie har dissat i sociala medier.

programme.title: Twenties: I've Got The World On A String
programme.desc: Hattie försöker lära sig kontorspolitiken på sin första dag som assistent. Marie har bekymmer med sin spelande mamma, och Nia chansar på en dejt med sin yogakund.

programme.title: Twenties: Happy Place
programme.desc: Hattie letar förgäves sin 'lyckliga skrivplats'. Marie ställs mot studions enda andra svarta chef, och Nia ifrågasätter sitt karriärval.

programme.title: Twenties: You Know How I Like It
programme.desc: Hattie har tiden emot sig när hon ilar genom Hollywood på olika uppdrag från Ida B. Nia kämpar med en audition.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Stora sex-väntningar
programme.desc: Kyle och Nick har en grabbkväll som slutar i fängelset efter ett barslagsmål på Shooters.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Fånga henne i en lögn
programme.desc: Efter att ha tagit emot ett slag från Billy, drar en frustrerad Jake ut på vägen. Han hamnar i en liten stad där han besöker sitt ex och hennes åttaåriga son.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Män kommer från Melrose
programme.desc: Jake ser ännu en chans att vinna tillbaka Alison. Nick hotar både Taylor och Peter efter att ha tagit äventyrande bilder.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Frames 'R' Us
programme.desc: En näst intill pank Craig flyttar in i lägenhet 8 i Melrose för att fortsätta sin jakt och hämnd på Amanda.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Skrik från ett äktenskap
programme.desc: Josh fortsätter Kimberlys plan att få Megan och Michael att göra slut när han spelar ut alla tre mot varandra och förbereder för att få Megan gripen.

programme.title: Melrose Place: 101 förbannelser
programme.desc: Megan lider ännu mer när hon vräks från sitt hus efter att ryktet sprids om hennes gripande (och tidigare liv).

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 407

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 501
programme.desc: Martin Ellinghams planer på att återuppta sin karriär som konsult i London avbryts i och med födseln av hans son som han fick tillsammans med den nu främmande Louisa Glasson.

programme.desc: Den nya receptionisten, Morwenna Newcross, får en dålig start efter att ha kommit sent på sin första arbetsdag. Hennes hyperaktiva beteende får Martin att tro att hon är hög på droger.

programme.desc: Kris returns to Raintree Ranch after ninety days at Camp Lagrange and begins the healing process.

programme.title: Wildfire: Mothers

programme.desc: Kris feels responsible when Oklahoma Crude is injured during a work out race with Wildfire so she gets a job at a local diner to help out, although it might SVt be eSVugh.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Claiming Race

programme.title: Wildfire: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Kris and her companions track lost horses in the woods while the Ritter family grows emotionally.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Track
programme.desc: Kris investigates the seamy underworld of the race track after Wildfire comes down with colic.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Bryan Mills och hans fru är i Istanbul när de blir kidnappade. Mannen som håller dom som gisslan visar sig vara far till en av de män som tidigare kidnappat Mills dotter, och som han under fritagandet av dottern dödat.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Två rivaliserande fastighetsmäklare tvingas samarbeta för att sälja ett speciellt hus, ägt av en känd botaniker och mistelodlare, före jul.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy säljer sin avlidna fasters välgörenhetsorganisation. Men Otto, som brukade arbeta som volontär där, vill anordna en sista välgörenhetsjulmiddag.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunchef tar hjälp av en barndomsvän för att arrangera stadens välgörenhetsevenemang, samtidigt som hon parar ihop honom med sin väninna.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy balanserar julens åtaganden, sin dotter och motstridiga känslor för sin ex-make, allt medan en mystisk skojare orsakar förödelse i Candy Cane Lane.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Den hyllade magikern Stanley Crawford bländar sin publik med konststycken av övernaturlig karaktär. Men själv är Stanley en skeptiker när det handlar om det oförklarliga. In i hans liv träder Sophie Baker som är medium, spåkvinna och förförerska.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: Sommersby

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Deaths-Head Revisited
programme.desc: A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Shelter
programme.desc: When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programme.desc: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Judgment Night

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Maroon 8

programme.desc: Team Scorpion måste samarbeta med sin gamla nemesis Mark Collins för att förhindra att mänskligheten dör ut. Walter och Paige har också svårt att navigera i sitt nya förhållande.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Nuke Kids on the Block

programme.title: CBS Morning News
programme.desc: Join Errol Barnett for the CBS Morning News weekdays at 7AM ET. Featuring the latest breaking news, in depth original reporting and news making interviews plus all the big stories impacting Americans from coast to coast.

programme.title: CBS Mornings
programme.desc: Reporting on international news stories, interviews, and in-depth pieces, covering topics from news, sports, climate and technology to race, health, parenting and personal finance.

programme.title: CBS News 24/7 Mornings
programme.desc: Se på CBS News, dygnet runt och följ de senaste världstäckande nyheterna med spännade reportage och heta diskussioner.

programme.title: CBS News 24/7
programme.desc: Coverage, reporting and storytelling from CBS News and Stations; a look at how news coverage comes together.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: Young naturalist Alfred Wallace was mystified: why were the flora and fauna of Bali and Lombok so radically different?

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 7
programme.desc: Learn about space weather, supercell storms, volcanoes, and St. Elmo's Fire.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Combat Medics
programme.desc: In the field of honor there is one group that stands above the rest: combat medics. They are there to help aid the wounded soldier, even if it is under heavy fire.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Conqueror
programme.desc: Humankind conquered the world, in order to survive, and conquers his fellow humans with new ideas. We will see how we as a species have conquered the earth, how we still compete with viruses, and how quantum theory conquers China.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Reconnaissance
programme.desc: Knowing an enemies strengths and weaknesses is one of the key elements of success in combat. Reconnaissance units are specially trained soldiers and marines who go behind enemy lines to gather intelligence about the enemy force.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Coasts
programme.desc: The episode Coasts shows the magnificence of the German North Sea and Baltic Coastlines and presents unique animal footage filmed over more than five years.

programme.title: On the Case: Taken
programme.desc: In the span of 8 months, 3 young girls are kidnapped from their homes and murdered. When their killer strikes again a young girl's heroic actions solves the case.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Omen
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the disturbing disappearance case of a teenager who vanished without a trace from a cinema car park.

programme.title: On the Case: In Plain Sight
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman is murdered the evidence points detectives to a killer hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Bird Key
programme.desc: A successful business man is found brutally murdered in his palatial Southern Florida home. A mysterious backpack found at the crime scene is the key to the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Kidnapped on the 4th of July
programme.desc: When a young woman's pizza delivery car is found abandoned in the middle of the desolate stretch of road, a twenty three year mystery begins.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Carnage
programme.desc: When 25 year old Laci Hill vanishes without a trace; police receive the key to solving the mystery from her kidnapper's wife.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Snowplane
programme.desc: Joe races a quirky antique snowmobile - with an airplane engine and no brakes. The water bomber crew struggles to get two planes out of Turkey. Cocky rampie Chris Staples tries to prove himself in the C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Lock
programme.desc: A cold snap triggers massive challenges. Devan runs into gear problems while he ferries a mothballed DC-3 across the country. And Justin has to make a snap decision with his newborn son aboard his plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Camp
programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Solid
programme.desc: AJ and James battle a DC-4 engine fire. It's Joe's 69th birthday - and he's never flown a helicopter before, so Mikey plans a special gift of chopper flight lessons.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Houdini
programme.desc: Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: Clark Gable plays Jim Gannon, a school-of-hard-knocks newspaperman who despises journalism schools, until he sees who's doing the teaching.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Green Room
programme.desc: After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: One-Percent Warrior
programme.desc: After his devastatingly fast, samurai-style combat approach sets filmmakers against him, a legendary action star (Tak Sakaguchi) films his own movie—on turf claimed by feuding yakuza gangs, including Japan’s deadliest martial arts assassin.

programme.title: Foggy Mountain
programme.desc: The film revolves around the story of Phi - a retired martial artist, longing for a peaceful life with a beautiful wife named Lanh.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahilo are two high school girls who are about to graduate. They also happen to both be highly skilled assassins. When the organization they work for orders them to share a room, the relationship between them turns sour.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: A trio of university parapsychologists lose their research grant and decide to open their own business, "Ghostbusters," and almost at once are summoned to investigate the strange happenings in a Central Park West apartment.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Directed by Ivan Reitman. Starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis, Annie Potts. The Ghostbusters attempt to rid New York City of the slime and negative energy that plagues it.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Bombshell
programme.desc: The provocative real story of three smart, ambitious, strong women who anchored one of America’s top news networks—and risked everything to stand up to the man who made them.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Speed Racer
programme.desc: The Wachowski Brothers bring a classic anime to the big screen: Matthew Fox, John Goodman, Christina Ricci, and Susan Sarandon star with Emile Hirsch as Speed Racer!

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Extraordinary Measures (Cbs Films)
programme.desc: Determination pushes an idealistic father into joining forces with a reclusive medical researcher to find a cure before it's too late. Harrison Ford and Brendan Fraser star in this true story of the power of love and faith against impossible odds.

programme.title: Failure to Launch

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Mid-Century
programme.desc: Academy Award Nominee Bruce Dern and Stephen Lang star in this horror tale about a couple renting a vacation home who meet the spirits of the architect and his two wives—plus their deranged, living son.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Bloody revenge is at the heart of this stylish action-thriller that doses the classic femme fatale story with a shot of adrenaline as it follows a former assassin who will stop at nothing to cut ties to her past.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: After being blinded in a coup against the king, Joseon’s greatest swordsman goes into hiding, far removed from his city’s anguish. But when traffickers kidnap his daughter, he has no choice but to unsheathe his sword once more.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef quits his job in LA after refusing to compromise with its owner; he is left to figure out what's next. He teams up with his ex, a friend & his son to launch a food truck, reigniting his passion for the kitchen and zest for life.

programme.title: Rachel Getting Married
programme.desc: When Kym returns to the Buchman family home for her sister Rachel's wedding, she brings a long history of personal crises, family conflict, and tragedy. Rated -R

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Most Beautiful Island
programme.desc: An undocumented woman struggling in NYC is offered an opportunity she can’t refuse, but soon discovers she’s involved in a dangerous game. Grand Jury Award Winner of SXSW 2017. Official Selection of BAMCinemaFest, Fantasia Fest, and Sidewalk.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: Woman Walks Ahead
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this riveting western follows a headstrong New York widow (Jessica Chastain) as she journeys west to meet Sioux chief Sitting Bull, facing off with an army officer (Sam Rockwell) intent on war with Native Americans.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

programme.title: Sanctified
programme.desc: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, 'Sanctified' is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance at a local church.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Seymour — an orphan and a nerd who works in a run-down flower shop on Skid Row — spends his time doing menial tasks and dreaming of his co-worker, Audrey. Then, one day, just after an eclipse of the sun, Seymour discovers a strange plant.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Basic
programme.desc: A former Army Ranger, now working as a DEA agent, is called in to investigate the disappearance of a drill sergeant and several cadets during a training mission that went disastrously wrong in the Panamanian jungle.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When the mob murders policeman Truman Gates' younger brother, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Extraordinary Measures (Cbs Films)
programme.desc: Determination pushes an idealistic father into joining forces with a reclusive medical researcher to find a cure before it's too late. Harrison Ford and Brendan Fraser star in this true story of the power of love and faith against impossible odds.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: The Score
